3:
TRNM load bench with configurable conflict rate

Usage: trnm-bench [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --txs <TXS>
          Number of transactions [default: 20000]
      --persist-profile
          Persist profile output under run/bench (enabled by default when --profile is set)
      --keys <KEYS>
          Number of hot keys (smaller = higher conflict) [default: 2000]
      --workload <WORKLOAD>
          Workload model [default: classic] [possible values: classic, mixed, hot-streak]
      --strategy <STRATEGY>
          Grouping strategy [default: original] [possible values: original, footprint-desc, write-first, write-last, hot-bucket-interleave, auto-adaptive, aggressive-greedy]
      --read-fanout <READ_FANOUT>
          Read-set fanout for mixed workload [default: 3]
      --write-every <WRITE_EVERY>
          Write every N txs for mixed workload (1 = write every tx) [default: 1]
      --profile
          Print executor profiling stats
      --determinism-repeats <DETERMINISM_REPEATS>
          Repeat the exact deterministic grouping input in-process and fail if any replay produces a different ordered group assignment. This checks scheduler determinism only; it is not a throughput or consensus claim [default: 0]
  -h, --help
          Print help
